clauses.reason: Section 1 of Executive Order 10892, signed 1960-11-08, amends section 6 of Executive Order 10152 of August 17, 1950 to read as a new text on submarine-duty incentive pay: members attached to an active submarine, including one under construction from the time builders’ trials commence, "shall be entitled to receive incentive pay" for submarine duty, with the same entitlement for operators and crew members of operational self-propelled submersibles and for periods of training and rehabilitation on nuclear-powered submarines. Later event: Executive Order 11120, signed 1963-10-02 and effective as of 1963-10-01, restates section 6 of EO 10152 again ("Section 6 is amended to read as follows") with a rewritten text. Before: entitlement for members attached to an active submarine (including one in builders’ trials) and submersible crews, with nuclear-submarine training and rehabilitation periods as determined by the Secretary of the Navy. After: entitlement as determined by the Secretary of the Navy, extended to members qualified in submarines assigned as prospective crew or under instruction for assignment to a submarine of advanced design, with nuclear training and rehabilitation periods, and submersible crews. The substance of the section changed, which a reviewer should note. Under the owner’s strike-and-insert ruling the clause continues, amended, until the order ends, so the 1963 restatement is a later event and not the first end; the alternative reading, that the 1963 restatement ended this order’s section 6 text on 1963-10-01, is disclosed as an earlier candidate. First end: Executive Order 11157, signed 1964-06-22 (published 1964-06-24), revokes this order by number: its section 502 says "The following Executive orders are revoked:" and lists "Executive Order No. 10892 of November 8,1960." (item (j)) alongside EO 10152 and EO 11120. EO 11157 has no effective-date wording, so the signing date is recorded; the filing date 1964-06-22 and publication date 1964-06-24 are the alternative readings.

Section 2 of Executive Order 10892 makes the order effective as of July 12, 1960, a retroactive effective-date provision. It commands nothing after it took effect on 1960-07-12, so no earlier end exists for it; it remains part of the order and is recorded as ending with the order. First end: Executive Order 11157, signed 1964-06-22, revokes the order by number (section 502, item (j): "Executive Order No. 10892 of November 8,1960."), as described for section 1.

research_rationale:
EO 10892 amends EO 10152 on submarine-duty incentive pay with an effective-as-of clause; provisional status no. I read the held registered Federal Register text, confirmed identity and a two-clause inventory (section 1 and section 2). EO 11120 restated the section in 1963 (a later event, with before and after text and a note that the substance changed). EO 11157 (1964-06-22) revokes the order by number and is the first end in held evidence. The machine searches carry no coverage warning and show no hit.

savings.reason: EO 11157 has no saving or exception clause (the held text was searched for effective, take effect, shall become, except, notwithstanding, hereafter; the only hit is the unrelated words heretofore or hereafter provided in section 402, and there is no effective-date wording). Incentive pay earned for submarine duty while the amended section 6 ran is an accrued effect that rests on the pay statute, not on this order, and does not keep the order operative.
